author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Twenty corners, a beeper on every one. Sweep the field row by row, turning at each wall, until nothing is left on the ground.
brief.es: Veinte esquinas y un zumbador en cada una. Barre el campo fila a fila, girando en cada muro, hasta no dejar nada en el suelo.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION turnright AS
    BEGIN
        turnleft;
        turnleft;
        turnleft
    END
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION harvest-row AS
    BEGIN
        pickbeeper;
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
        BEGIN
            move;
            pickbeeper
        END
    END
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION next-row AS
    BEGIN
        IF facing-east THEN
        BEGIN
            turnleft;
            move;
            turnleft
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            turnright;
            move;
            turnright
        END
    END
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        harvest-row;
        ITERATE 3 TIMES
        BEGIN
            next-row;
            harvest-row
        END
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
